text.description_html:
Deltana SS44058TA32D, 4" x 4" x 5/8" Radius Satin Stainless Steel Residential Steel Hinge

Sold and priced as a pair, these 4" security door hinges are made out of stainless steel. They have a 5/8" radius on one leaf and a square corner on the other. For use on doors that open outward where the hinge pins are outside the door. These extra security door hinges have locking tabs that join the 2 hinge leaves together when door is closed. This holds a closed door in place even if the door hinges are tampered with (if hinge pins are removed or cut).

Direct fit replacement for THERMA-TRU door hinges (4 Inch Square & Rounded Corner).

Package includes a pair of hinges (2), matching finish flathead, Phillips Drive #10 x 1" wood screws. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications of the 4 Inch Security Door Hinge:

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: 5/8" Radius Leaf
  • Corners: Square Leaf
  • Thickness: 0.085" (Residential)
  • Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #10 x 3/4"
  • Security Tabs: Lock Tab to Join Hinge Leaves
  • Deltana SS440587TA Hinge Specifications (PDF)

Sold in Pairs (2 Hinges)
